verdict.rationale: The flow docs say actions can include "running code", which implies a code step inside a workflow. Separately, custom pieces can be built in TypeScript, but that is building integrations rather than dropping inline code into a step. The evidence never names the language for the code step, never mentions Python, and gives no detail on how the code step works. Missing for 10: confirmation of JavaScript/TypeScript inline code steps, any Python support, documentation of the code step's inputs/outputs/packages, and hands-on corroboration.
